steps.label: Paket pruefen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && rm -f sr3_done.txt && cat sr3_aa sr3_ab sr3_ac sr3_ad sr3_ae sr3_af sr3_ag > sr3.tgz && [ "$(md5 -q sr3.tgz)" = 89b6ff6dcc614d0be49993a67c118cda ] && rm -rf sr && mkdir sr && tar xzf sr3.tgz -C sr && rm -f sr3_a? && ls sr/bundle/public | wc -l

steps.label: Video rendern
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render sr/bundle P sr_out3.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: Ton und Vorschau
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i sr_out3.mp4 -i sr/mix.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest sears_film3.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i sears_film3.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 27 -preset veryfast -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:a copy sears_film3_vorschau.mp4 && tar czf sr3v.tgz sears_film3_vorschau.mp4 && ls -l sr3v.tgz sears_film3.mp4 > sr3_done.txt
